text_block_list.text:
To be honest, her physical strength is 
still lacking. Even so, we decided to 
enter the first leg of the Classic Triple 
Crown, the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... There's definitely a difference 
in size. But you know... Even more than 
that..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"The difference in 'visual appeal' is way 
too huge! City, you stand out way too 
much~."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? I don't really have the luxury 
to worry about that, though. It's an 
important race.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Man, Gold City always looks even better 
than her track record suggests. Could it 
be that even in races...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
By comparison, Tamamo Cross... kind of 
looks a bit frail.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Rumor has it that Umamusume who look like 
this don't usually make it big, but..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, hold up! Don't just judge 
things at a glance!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's come to this, I'll show 'em 
all! Listen here, City. Horse girls aren't 
all about looks.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna make this whole venue explode 
with excitement with my running!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
By bringing down the house...? Like, 
making people burst out laughing?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hell no! I'm tellin' you to make a huge 
scene! Not a bad funny line, though!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Don't go thinking I'll run like a 
goofball in the race though! I'll be 
delivering the punchline down the final 
stretch!"

Tamamo Cross heads onto the turf full of 
vigor. I can't wait to see this 
gold-and-silver showdown against Gold 
City.
